fields.why: Tables 1-2 report adjusted t-test p-values for each race/ethnicity group (5 levels) and each age group against a stated reference level; these are SPD results across 3+ groups.
Race/ethnicity (White ref, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Other) and age (45-64 or 40-64 ref, several other bands) each have 3+ groups; sex has only 2 and stays out.
Each group is tested only against the 'reference' row (White; 45-64 years); no omnibus, trend or all-pairs test is reported.
